evidencepack/vcs-posture@v1./repositories_present: Checks whether the include and exclude patterns select any project in the group's project list.
evidencepack/vcs-posture@v1./branch_protection/pr_required_repositor: Counts the assessed projects whose protected branch rules for the default branch let no role, user, group, or deploy key push.
evidencepack/vcs-posture@v1./branch_protection/approving_reviews_rep: Counts the assessed projects where the project's approvals_before_merge, or an approval rule that applies to the default branch, requires at least one approval. A report_approver rule counts only when its report_type is any_merge_request.
evidencepack/vcs-posture@v1./branch_protection/status_checks_reposit: Counts the assessed projects whose only_allow_merge_if_pipeline_succeeds is true in the group's project list.

evidencepack/access-posture@v1./sign_in/sso_configured: True when a member in the group's member list has a group_saml_identity.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./sign_in/scim_enabled: True when a member in the group's member list has a group_scim_identity.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./members/members_present: Checks whether the group's member list has an active member who is not a bot user. The list includes inherited and invited members.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./members/member_count: Counts the active members in the group's member list and leaves out bot users. The list includes inherited and invited members.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./members/sso_member_count: Counts the members in member_count that have a group_saml_identity.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./members/sso_coverage_pct: Divides sso_member_count by member_count and rounds down.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./members/local_members_present: Checks whether member_count is above 0. GitLab's API has no field for whether a group enforces SSO-only sign-in, so every member counts as able to sign in without SSO.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./members/local_member_count: Counts every member in member_count, including those with a group_saml_identity. GitLab's API has no field for whether a group enforces SSO-only sign-in, so a member with a SAML identity may still have a password.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./members/local_mfa_member_count: Counts the members in local_member_count whose two_factor_enabled is true.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./members/local_mfa_coverage_pct: Divides local_mfa_member_count by local_member_count and rounds down.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./members/inactive_member_count: Counts the members in member_count whose last_activity_on in the group's billable members list is empty or before the date 90 days before the run. A sign-in sets last_activity_on, and so does Git or API use.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./members/inactive_pct: Divides inactive_member_count by member_count and rounds up.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./admins/admins_present: Checks whether a member in member_count has the Owner role in the group.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./admins/admin_count: Counts the members in member_count who have the Owner role in the group.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./admins/admin_share_pct: Divides admin_count by member_count and rounds up.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./admins/local_admins_present: Checks whether admin_count is above 0. GitLab's API has no field for whether a group enforces SSO-only sign-in, so every Owner counts as able to sign in without SSO.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./admins/local_admin_count: Counts every Owner in admin_count, including those with a group_saml_identity. GitLab's API has no field for whether a group enforces SSO-only sign-in, so an Owner with a SAML identity may still have a password.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./admins/local_mfa_admin_count: Counts the Owners in local_admin_count whose two_factor_enabled is true.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./admins/local_admin_mfa_coverage_pct: Divides local_mfa_admin_count by local_admin_count and rounds down.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./credentials/credentials_present: Checks whether the group or an assessed project has an active access token, or an assessed project has a deploy key that has not expired.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./credentials/credential_count: Counts the active access tokens of the group and of the assessed projects. Each deploy key enabled in an assessed project counts once, unless it has expired.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./credentials/never_expiring_credential_c: Counts the credentials in credential_count that have no expires_at.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./credentials/never_expiring_pct: Divides never_expiring_credential_count by credential_count and rounds up.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./credentials/unused_credential_count: Counts the credentials in credential_count whose last_used_at is empty or more than 90 days before the run.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./credentials/unused_pct: Divides unused_credential_count by credential_count and rounds up.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./credentials/unrestricted_credential_cou: Counts the access tokens in credential_count that have the api scope, which allows every API call the token's role allows. Deploy keys do not count. When the group's ip_restriction_ranges is set, no credential counts, since that restriction applies to every token and deploy key.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./credentials/unrestricted_pct: Divides unrestricted_credential_count by credential_count and rounds up.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./credentials/write_access_credential_cou: Counts the access tokens in credential_count with a scope that can write, such as api or write_repository. A deploy key counts when it can push to an assessed project.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./credentials/write_access_pct: Divides write_access_credential_count by credential_count and rounds up.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./credentials/rotation_overdue_credential: Counts the credentials in credential_count whose created_at is more than 90 days before the run.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./credentials/rotation_overdue_pct: Divides rotation_overdue_credential_count by credential_count and rounds up.

evidencepack/vuln-scanning@v1./scanners/*/enabled: True when at least one assessed project has the scanner in its securityScanners pipelineRun list in GitLab's GraphQL API.
evidencepack/vuln-scanning@v1./scanners/*/resources_present: Checks whether the include and exclude patterns select any project in the group's project list.
evidencepack/vuln-scanning@v1./scanners/*/scanned_resource_count: Counts the assessed projects whose securityScanners pipelineRun list has the scanner. That list holds the scanners whose jobs succeeded in the latest pipeline on the default branch.
evidencepack/vuln-scanning@v1./scanners/*/coverage_pct: Divides scanned_resource_count by resource_count and rounds down.
evidencepack/vuln-scanning@v1./scanners/*/open_critical_present: Checks whether the group's vulnerability report has a detected or confirmed critical vulnerability from the scanner in an assessed project.
evidencepack/vuln-scanning@v1./scanners/*/open_high_present: Checks whether the group's vulnerability report has a detected or confirmed high vulnerability from the scanner in an assessed project.
evidencepack/vuln-scanning@v1./scanners/*/overdue_present: Checks whether an open critical vulnerability from the scanner was detected more than 30 days before the run, or an open high one more than 90 days before.
evidencepack/vuln-scanning@v1./scanners/*/open_critical_count: Counts the detected and confirmed critical vulnerabilities from the scanner in the assessed projects.
evidencepack/vuln-scanning@v1./scanners/*/open_high_count: Counts the detected and confirmed high vulnerabilities from the scanner in the assessed projects.
evidencepack/vuln-scanning@v1./scanners/*/open_medium_count: Counts the detected and confirmed medium vulnerabilities from the scanner in the assessed projects.
evidencepack/vuln-scanning@v1./scanners/*/open_low_count: Counts the detected and confirmed low vulnerabilities from the scanner in the assessed projects.
evidencepack/vuln-scanning@v1./scanners/*/overdue_critical_count: Counts the vulnerabilities in open_critical_count whose detectedAt is more than 30 days before the run.
evidencepack/vuln-scanning@v1./scanners/*/overdue_high_count: Counts the vulnerabilities in open_high_count whose detectedAt is more than 90 days before the run.
